candidate_tasks.title: Add focused EnterPlanMode TS parity red tests for strict empty input, context gates, and message-only output
implementation_steps: Create tests that encode the current TS no-input schema, channel/agent-context availability, and model-facing response contract before changing implementation.
acceptance: Tests fail against the current Go behavior where it diverges from TS and pass once this task set is complete.

candidate_tasks.title: Enforce strict empty input schema and context-sensitive availability gates
implementation_steps: Mirror TS channel, agent-context, and non-interactive availability rules.
Expose registry metadata only when the TS tool would be visible.
acceptance: Calling EnterPlanMode with any input key fails.
Unsupported contexts do not expose or do reject EnterPlanMode consistently with TS.

candidate_tasks.title: Align EnterPlanMode output to TS message-only contract and remove immediate plan-file creation side effect
implementation_steps: Return the TS model-facing instruction text without Go-only JSON data.
Move or delete timestamped plan-file materialization from EnterPlanMode when TS does not do it at entry time.
Keep any implementation-internal state out of the model-visible tool result.
acceptance: Tool result text matches TS fixtures.
No Go-only plan-file path leaks into the model-visible result.

candidate_tasks.title: Implement real plan permission-mode transition and pre-plan state capture
implementation_steps: Capture the pre-plan permission/auto-mode state before activation.
Switch runtime permission mode through the same dispatcher used by other tools instead of local-only flags.
Make ExitPlanMode restore the captured state.
acceptance: Write tools are blocked because runtime permission state changed, not because of ad hoc checks only.
ExitPlanMode restores the original permission mode.

candidate_tasks.title: Wire plan-mode lifecycle attachments, prompt metadata, and UI/runtime flags
implementation_steps: Attach plan-mode state to app/session state used by prompt assembly.
Emit the TS equivalent prompt metadata and UI flags.
Avoid duplicate reminders across compaction or resume.
acceptance: Prompt assembly and UI state can observe plan mode exactly once while active.
Compaction/resume does not duplicate or lose the plan-mode reminder.

candidate_tasks.title: Replace misleading EnterPlanMode tests with TS parity fixtures
implementation_steps: Remove or rewrite tests that assert Go-only plan-file behavior as public contract.
Add fixtures for duplicate entry, invalid input, supported contexts, and Enter/Exit handoff.
acceptance: Tests protect TS behavior rather than Go-specific convenience behavior.
